ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of gifts round the fire

plain.li: We were all round the fire in my dream, and each of us had a small gift wrapped in cloth, and we waited for the last one to sit down before we opened them.
In the dream the fire burned all night without anyone feeding it, and every time I looked into it I saw someone I was fond of.
Somebody had made me a present in my dream, carved and polished, and they wouldn't say who.
[child] I got a present in my dream that was exactly what I wanted, and I didn't even have to say.

warm.li: Dreamt I chose the right gift for each of them, every single one, and got to watch their faces.

blunt.li: Gift dream. Got a good one. Kept it.

cheerful.li: The fire in my dream threw sparks shaped like stars, and we all made wishes on them!

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the day again. It's already over. They always go so fast.

cold.li: Gifts were exchanged in my dream. Mine was adequate.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the day's sport

plain.li: I was running a race in my dream, and the finish kept moving back, and I kept gaining on it anyway.
In the dream we were out at first light after a great stag, all of us strung out across the hills, not a word between us.
Dreamt they were handing out the prizes, and when my name came up, the ribbon was longer than I am tall.
[child] I won every race in my dream, even the one against the dog.

warm.li: Dreamt there was a prize for each of us, even the slowest, and the slowest was the proudest.

blunt.li: Dreamt of the contest. Won. Want a rematch awake.

cheerful.li: In my dream I threw the stone so far it never came down!

gloomy.li: Lost again, in my dream. Same as the real one.

cold.li: I studied the others' form in my dream. Next time.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a long morning

plain.li: In my dream I woke late with no work waiting, and the sun was already halfway across the floor.
Dreamt the day of rest went on for a week, and the fields grew all by themselves.
I lay in the grass in my dream and watched one cloud cross the whole sky.

warm.li: Dreamt we all slept late and had breakfast at noon, together, in no hurry.

blunt.li: Rest day dream. Did nothing. Again.

cheerful.li: I took a nap in my dream, inside my sleep. Very efficient!

gloomy.li: Dreamt of another day of rest. The work will all still be there tomorrow.

cold.li: A dream about idleness. I found it restorative. I'm told that's the idea.

plain.li: In my dream we were all in a line passing things hand to hand, seed and stone and timber, and the line reached into the next valley.
Dreamt the new roofs went up in a single day, theirs beside ours, and at dusk you couldn't tell which houses were whose.
The whole field was planted in my dream before the sun was high, with all of us bent over the same rows.

warm.li: Dreamt we helped them and they helped us, back and forth, until nobody could remember who owed whom.

blunt.li: Worked all night in my sleep, shoulder to shoulder. Back aches.

cheerful.li: In my dream so many people turned up to help that we finished before lunch and had a party!

gloomy.li: We worked side by side in my dream. Then they went home, and so did we.

cold.li: A dream of shared labor. Efficient. Good relations have their uses.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the warlord's fall

plain.li: I saw the warlord fall again in my dream, slowly, like a tree going over, and the whole field went quiet.
In the dream the warband's banners were lying in the mud, and people from every town were stepping over them on their way home.
Dreamt the warlord's horse came to our gate without a rider and stood there, waiting to be let in.

warm.li: Dreamt the roads were safe, and children from three towns were playing where the warband used to camp.

blunt.li: Dreamt the warlord fell. Did fall. Good.

cheerful.li: In my dream the whole region threw a feast for the warlord's fall, and we were the guests of honor!

gloomy.li: The warlord fell in my dream, and another one stood up in the same place.

cold.li: The warlord fell again in my sleep. It ended as it should have.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of riders at night

plain.li: Riders on the road in my dream with the warlord at the front, looking straight at our walls as they passed.
The warlord was sitting at our table in my dream, eating our bread, and we all kept our eyes on our plates.
Hoofbeats all night in the dream, coming closer and never arriving.

warm.li: I hid the children in the cellar in my dream and stood at the top of the stairs until the riders went past.

blunt.li: Warlord dream. Checked the gate. Barred.

cheerful.li: In my dream the warband rode past and every one of their horses threw a shoe!

gloomy.li: They're still out there. In my dream they came back. They will.

cold.li: A dream about the warlord, still at large. A reasonable thing to worry about.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of songs on the road

plain.li: Pilgrims were singing on the road in my dream, and the song had our colony's name in it.
In the dream two old enemies sat at our table and passed each other the salt, and someone outside was singing.
Dreamt I knew the words to the strangers' song, every verse, and sang it back to them across the fields.
[child] The grown-ups were all singing in my dream, and the birds joined in too.

warm.li: Dreamt the whole region was singing one song, and every town took a verse.

blunt.li: Singing in my dream. Good song. Can't remember it.

cheerful.li: Somebody wrote a song about us in my dream, and it rhymed!

gloomy.li: The singing faded down the road in my dream until I couldn't hear it anymore.

cold.li: The tune from my dream has stayed with me, unfortunately.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of wings over the fields

plain.li: The sky went dark with wings in my dream, and the sound of them was like rain that never landed.
In the dream I walked the bare fields with a sack of seed, planting again right behind the swarm.
Dreamt every locust in the swarm turned into a grain of wheat, and they all fell back down into the furrows.

warm.li: Dreamt the towns that lost everything came to share our harvest, and there was enough to go round.

blunt.li: Locusts. In my dream too. Can't get away from them.

cheerful.li: In my dream the chickens ate every locust in the valley and got very fat!

gloomy.li: The swarm came back in my dream and took the rest.

cold.li: A dream about the swarm. I've been thinking about seed stores since. That's useful, at least.

plain.li: The players were back in my dream, and this time I was up there with them, and I knew all my lines.
In the dream the show went on all night, and the masks kept changing, and one of them was my own face.
Dreamt the juggler threw me a ball and I caught it, and threw it back, and we kept it going back and forth across the stage.
[child] In my dream I ran away with the players and learned to walk on my hands.

warm.li: Dreamt we all laughed at the same joke at the same moment, and it went on a long time.

blunt.li: Players again, in my dream. Good show.

cheerful.li: I was the star of the show in my dream, and I didn't trip once!

gloomy.li: The players packed up their wagon in my dream and left before the end.

cold.li: I worked out how the trick was done, in my dream. It was obvious.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the road home

plain.li: In my dream I walked with them again, all the way to their door, and someone inside was already running out to meet them.
Dreamt the people we saw through were safe somewhere far off, eating supper, and one of them said our names.
The road home went on and on in my dream, but every mile of it was downhill.

warm.li: Dreamt the ones we helped came back years later, well and grown, just to see us again.

blunt.li: Got them home, in my dream. Got them home awake too.

cheerful.li: Dreamt they threw us a party at the other end, with ribbons on every post!

gloomy.li: I kept looking back down the road in my dream, wondering if they'd made it.

cold.li: The journey went as planned in my dream. The end was satisfying.
